name: WristCam
summary: WristCam is a wrist-worn camera and inertial-sensing module for collecting close-range human interaction data. It complements first-person or global views with detailed hand-object and tool-object observations for robot learning and fine manipulation training. The module combines a fisheye camera, synchronized IMU data and wireless connectivity.
